# apple_subscription_group_localization (Resource)

Sets a subscription group's display name, and optionally the app name shown with it, for one locale. Changes go to the version being prepared; when the current version has been reviewed, applying starts the next one. Changes fail while a version is in review. Destroying the resource deletes the localization from the version being prepared, and otherwise leaves it. Import it with `<subscription_group_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_group_localization" "en_us" {
  subscription_group_id = apple_subscription_group.pro.id
  locale                = "en-US"
  name                  = "Example Pro"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `name` (String) Display name of the group, 2 to 75 characters.
- `subscription_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription group, e.g. `apple_subscription_group.example.id`.

### Optional

- `custom_app_name` (String) App name shown with the group, up to 30 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization, which changes with each version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_group_localization.en_us
  identity = {
    subscription_group_id = "21000000"
    locale                = "en-US"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `subscription_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the subscription group, e.g. `apple_subscription_group.example.id`.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription_group_localization.en_us 21000000/en-US
```
